drivingQuestion: From where is it derived that the inner goat atones for intentional defilement of the Temple and its sacred foods?
outcomeNote: the question is answered in the next unit (shevuot.sugya031)

segments.he: וְעַל זְדוֹן טוּמְאַת מִקְדָּשׁ וְקָדָשָׁיו, שָׂעִיר הַנַּעֲשֶׂה בִּפְנִים כּוּ׳. מְנָהָנֵי מִילֵּי?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And for» cases in which the «defiling of» the «Temple or its sacrificial» foods was carried out «intentionally,» the «goat whose» blood presentation is «performed inside» the Sanctuary on Yom Kippur, and Yom Kippur itself, atone. The Gemara asks: «From where are these matters» derived?
